builtin_known_table.source_note: simple continued fraction [1; 1, 1, 1, ...] of the golden ratio
periodic CF x = 2 + 1/x (silver ratio); sqrt(2) = x - 1
Brouncker 1655: 4/pi = 1 + 1^2/(2 + 3^2/(2 + 5^2/(2 + ...))); the constant-2 form equals 1 + 4/pi; no Moebius wrap with coefficients in [-2, 2] maps it to pi
Euler/Gauss: 4/pi = 1 + 1/(3 + 4/(5 + 9/(7 + 16/(9 + ...)))); reaching pi itself needs a wrap coefficient of 4, outside [-2, 2]
classical form pi = 3 + 1^2/(6 + 3^2/(6 + 5^2/(6 + ...))); the constant-6 family member equals pi + 3; the wrap to pi needs q = -3, outside [-2, 2]
Lambert 1761 tangent CF at z = 1: cot(1) = 1 - 1/(3 - 1/(5 - ...))
Lambert hyperbolic tangent CF at z = 1: coth(1) = 1 + 1/(3 + 1/(5 + ...))

config.grammar: CF(a, b) = a_0 + b_1/(a_1 + b_2/(a_2 + ...)); a_n = alpha0 + alpha1*n + alpha2*n^2; b_n = beta0 + beta1*n + beta2*n^2
config.mobius_dedup: exclude determinant zero; divide by gcd; flip sign so the first nonzero of (p, q, r, s) is positive; identity map included
config.shape_digit_order: base-9 little-endian: alpha0, alpha1, alpha2, beta0, beta1, beta2

scope: Exhaustive fp64 GPU enumeration of a declared ordinal-indexed continued-fraction family with Moebius wraps, matched against declared constants at 1e-12 and promoted only through mpmath digit-holdout stages at 60 and 120 digits.
